# durable-saga — results

**Simulated result.** Generated by `make report` from the module in this
directory. No cloud project, no credentials, no network. Re-running the
command reproduces this file byte for byte.

## 2. Scenarios

| id | scenario | final state | ledgers say | agree | effects | compensations | restarts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| S1 | Every participant says yes | `COMPLETED` | COMPLETED | yes | 6 | 0 | 0 |
| S2 | A compensable step is refused | `COMPENSATED` | COMPENSATED | yes | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| S3 | Failure before any durable effect | `COMPENSATED` | COMPENSATED | yes | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| S4 | The carrier answers after the saga gave up | `COMPENSATED` | COMPENSATED | yes | 2 | 2 | 0 |
| S5 | Cancellation loses the race | `COMPLETED` | COMPLETED | yes | 6 | 0 | 0 |
| S6 | The orchestrator dies mid-pivot | `COMPLETED` | COMPLETED | yes | 6 | 0 | 1 |
| S7 | A compensation fails, then an operator retries it | `COMPENSATED` | COMPENSATED | yes | 3 | 3 | 0 |
| S8 | A step after the pivot runs out of attempts | `COMPLETED` | COMPLETED | yes | 6 | 0 | 0 |
| S9 | The answer is lost, not the work | `COMPLETED` | COMPLETED | yes | 6 | 0 | 0 |

## 3. The failure matrix

39 runs. One fault at one point of one step, then the saga is driven
to quiescence and scored twice: by its own record, and by an auditor that reads
only the five participants' effect ledgers.

| injection | meaning |
|---|---|
| `reject` | the participant refuses, finally |
| `error` | the participant is briefly unavailable |
| `error-repeated` | the participant stays unavailable until the attempts run out |
| `lost` | the participant acts and the answer never arrives |
| `crash` | the orchestrator dies after the answer and before recording it |
| `predispatch` | the orchestrator dies before the command leaves |

| outcome | runs |
|---|---:|
| COMPLETED | 24 |
| COMPENSATED | 8 |
| MANUAL | 7 |
| PENDING | 0 |
| **disagreements between the saga and the ledgers** | **0** |
| **duplicate protected effects** | **0** |

The full table is in `matrix.md`.

## 4. Negative controls

Each mechanism is removed in turn, and a named observable has to change.

| mutation | probe | observable that changed |
|---|---|---|
| `no-step-dedupe` | the orchestrator dies after the pivot and retries it | a DUPLICATE_EFFECT appears in the participants' ledgers |
| `compensate-only-confirmed` | a cancellation while the carrier has not yet answered | the carrier books a shipment the saga believes it compensated, and the auditor disagrees |
| `forward-compensation-order` | the pivot is refused after a shipment has been booked | inventory refuses to release units a live shipment depends on, and the chain stops |
| `no-wait-correlation` | the carrier answers after the saga stopped waiting | the NO_WAIT_OUTSTANDING refusal disappears |
| `no-pivot-cancel-check` | a cancellation in flight while the pivot commits | a committed saga starts compensating and cannot void a captured payment |
| `compensate-with-current-spec` | a version 1 saga compensating a step version 2 has deleted | the compensation for a deleted step cannot be found |
| `no-attempt-cap` | a compensation the participant will never accept | the saga never leaves COMPENSATING |
| `orchestrator-forgets-compensation` | the pivot is refused and the chain runs | the saga claims COMPENSATED while the ledgers show the effects are live |

| mutation | unmutated run | mutated run |
|---|---|---|
| `no-step-dedupe` | COMPLETED / COMPLETED / agree / — / — / 6 effects | COMPLETED / COMPLETED / DISAGREE / DUPLICATE_EFFECT / — / 7 effects |
| `compensate-only-confirmed` | COMPENSATED / COMPENSATED / agree / — / NO_WAIT_OUTSTANDING / 2 effects | COMPENSATED / UNRESOLVED / DISAGREE / — / NO_WAIT_OUTSTANDING / 3 effects |
| `forward-compensation-order` | COMPENSATED / COMPENSATED / agree / — / — / 3 effects | COMPENSATION_FAILED / UNRESOLVED / agree / — / — / 3 effects |
| `no-wait-correlation` | COMPENSATED / COMPENSATED / agree / — / NO_WAIT_OUTSTANDING / 2 effects | COMPENSATED / COMPENSATED / agree / — / — / 2 effects |
| `no-pivot-cancel-check` | COMPLETED / COMPLETED / agree / — / CANCEL_LOST_THE_RACE / 6 effects | COMPENSATION_FAILED / UNRESOLVED / DISAGREE / COMPENSATED_AFTER_PIVOT / — / 4 effects |
| `compensate-with-current-spec` | COMPENSATED / COMPENSATED / agree / — / — / 3 effects | COMPENSATION_FAILED / UNRESOLVED / agree / — / — / 3 effects |
| `no-attempt-cap` | COMPENSATION_FAILED / UNRESOLVED / agree / — / — / 3 effects | COMPENSATING / UNRESOLVED / agree / — / — / 3 effects |
| `orchestrator-forgets-compensation` | COMPENSATED / COMPENSATED / agree / — / — / 3 effects | COMPENSATED / UNRESOLVED / DISAGREE / — / — / 3 effects |

Read as `state / ledger verdict / agreement / ledger violations / refusals / applied effects`.
